title: dep-scan mcp coverage input
description: The arguments the coverage tool of `depscan mcp` accepts: one scan directory whose coverage is reported. The server validates the arguments against this schema, so an unknown argument is a tool error rather than a silently ignored one.

scan_dir.description: The scan directory whose coverage is reported, as an absolute path. The tool refuses a path that does not resolve, with os.path.realpath, inside a root the server was started with.
